literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) reference the same commercial GeneCopoeia plasmid (NM_021189.4-HA) with no stated tag position. The rules explicitly exclude 'a commercial plasmid whose tag POSITION is unstated; you cannot pin insert_after_residue.' The topology_derived path cannot rescue these lines because the commercial-plasmid exclusion is explicit and takes precedence. CADM3 is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein (EC: 25–331, TM: 332–352, IC: 353–398); its N-terminus (after SP cleavage at residue 24, mature N-terminus = residue 25 N) is the sole extracellular terminus and would in principle be a topology_derived candidate, but the evidence does not qualify. The G368C variant studied in L2 falls at position 368 (intracellular, >352), confirming the paper is a disease-variant study, not a tag-engineering study. No qualifying insertion evidence exists in the ledger; zero sites is the correct answer.
